review_candidates.description: Description Position at Parts Town See What We’re All About As the fastest-growing distributor of restaurant equipment, HVAC and residential appliance parts, we like to do things a little differently. First, you need to understand and demonstrate our Core Values with safety being your first priority. That’s key. But we’re also looking for unique enthusiasm, high integrity, courage to embrace change…and if you know a few jokes, that puts you on the top of our list! Do you have a genius-level knowledge of original equipment manufacturer parts? If not, no problem! We’re more interested in passionate people with fresh ideas from different backgrounds. That’s what keeps us at the top of our game. We’re proud that our workplace has been recognized for its growth and innovation on the Inc. 5000 list 15 years in a row and the Crain’s Fast 50 list ten times. We are honored to be voted by our Chicagoland team as a Chicago Tribune Top Workplace for the last four years. If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves, go above and beyond and put your ambition to work, all while having some fun, let’s chat – Apply Today! Perks Parts Town Pride – check out our virtual tour and culture! Quarterly profit-sharing bonus Hybrid Work schedule Team member appreciation events and recognition programs Volunteer opportunities Casual dress code On demand pay options: Access your pay as you earn it, to cover unexpected or even everyday expenses All the traditional benefits like health insurance, 401k/401k match, employee assistance programs and time away – don’t worry, we’ve got you covered. The Job at a Glance The Senior Systems & Cloud Engineer designs builds, and operate primarily across Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), while supporting the on-premises systems that connect to them. This is a hands-on, cloud-focused role for an engineer who brings strong system-engineering fundamentals — Windows, Linux, networking, and identity — and applies them to building reliable, well-architected cloud environments. Terraform is central to how the role works: infrastructure is defined as reusable, version-controlled configurations rather than provisioned by hand. The ideal candidate pairs cloud engineering with a solid infrastructure background, bringing consistency, repeatability, and reliability to everything we run. This role will likely spend 50% of the time working within our Azure environment, 20% on-premises technologies, 20% on GCP and remainder time on other internal technologies. A passion for automation and process improvement is key. A Typical Day Administer, patch, and harden Windows Server and Linux systems across on-prem and cloud environments. Manage virtualization, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, certificates, and core infrastructure services. Provision and operate Azure and GCP compute, storage, networking, identity, and hybrid connectivity. Build secure cloud landing zones, support workload migrations, and optimize cost, tagging, and resource hygiene. Define and maintain Terraform configurations, modules, state, standards, and Git-based deployment workflows. Automate configuration and operational tasks with PowerShell, Bash, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices. Monitor systems, respond to alerts, support incidents, and ensure uptime, performance, capacity, and security. Maintain backup, disaster recovery, compliance, documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures. Partner with internal teams and vendors while mentoring others and standardizing platforms across data center and cloud. To Land This Opportunity You bring hands-on Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code experience, turning complex environments into clean, repeatable, version-controlled builds. You enjoy using PowerShell and Bash to automate the manual work others still do the hard way. You’re confident administering Windows Server and Linux environments and keeping critical systems secure, stable, and ready for what’s next. You understand virtualization, including Nutanix, and know how to keep hosts, clusters, capacity, and performance running smoothly. You’ve built in Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) across compute, storage, networking, identity, and serverless patterns — with an eye toward cloud environments that scale with the business. You know Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and certificate services — the core services that keep an enterprise connected. You can connect the dots across switching, VLANs, routing, firewalls, VPN, and hybrid connectivity between the data center and the cloud. Storage, backup, and disaster recovery are familiar territory, including SAN/NAS and backup tooling — because resilience is more than a buzzword. You look for smart ways to use PowerShell, Bash, or Python to make infrastructure faster, safer, and easier to support. Git-based version control and CI/CD pipelines are part of your infrastructure toolkit, bringing software-engineering discipline to systems work. You take pride in patch management, monitoring, and systems hardening, building environments that are both reliable and secure. You troubleshoot with curiosity and a root-cause mindset, digging past symptoms to solve the real problem. You communicate clearly in writing and conversation, translating technical complexity into practical next steps. Strong documentation and diagramming skills help you leave behind roadmaps others can follow. You balance planned projects, urgent incidents, and everything in between with strong time management and prioritization. You enjoy sharing knowledge and raising the technical bar for the people around you. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field — or equivalent hands-on experience 5+ years in systems engineering / infrastructure administration (Windows, Linux, virtualization) 5+ years building infrastructure in Azure and/or GCP Demonstrated hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code Solid networking, storage, and Active Directory fundamentals Microsoft Azure Administrator and/or Google Associate Cloud Engineer certification Experience operating hybrid environments that span on-premises data centers and public cloud About Your Future Team We are about working hard and playing hard. We are about having each other’s back, taking on responsibility and making things better for all. We are gritty, roll back your sleeves and get the job done with an inclusive, positive can-do attitude. We enjoy our social events, celebrating with food (of course) and celebrating our team members’ life’s milestones and events. At Parts Town, we value transparency and are committed to ensuring our team members feel appreciated and supported. We prioritize our positive workplace culture where collaboration, growth, and work-life balance are celebrated. The salary range for this role is $121,265.51– 162,254.66 annually which is based on including but not limited to qualifications, experience, and geographical location. Parts Town is a pay-for performance company. In addition to base pay, some roles offer a profit-sharing program, and an annual bonus depending on the role. Our comprehensive benefits package includes health, dental and vision insurance, 401(k) with match, employee assistance programs, paid time off, paid sick time off, paid holidays, paid parental leave, and professional development opportunities. review_candidates.description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. About The Team ABOUT THE JOB We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Network Administrator to join our Infrastructure Operations Team. Comprising network, systems, and GNOC analysts and administrators, this cross-functional team is pivotal in ensuring the seamless operation, continuous improvement, and robust maintenance of Anduril's critical infrastructure. As a core member of this team, your primary focus will be supporting Anduril's corporate and production network environments, providing direct support to internal teams and business units. Your expertise will be instrumental in the deployment, maintenance, and resilient support of highly sophisticated network architectures that underpin our global operations and innovative technologies. You will navigate complex environments spanning on-premises data centers, corporate office environments, and leading cloud platforms, ensuring optimal performance, security, and reliability across our critical systems. This role requires a proactive administrator capable of identifying operational efficiencies and troubleshooting complex issues within critical network infrastructure, contributing significantly across four major functions: Monitoring and Incident Management, Deployment, Operations, and Tooling / Automation. What You’ll Do Network Deployment & Maintenance: Deploy, configure, and maintain robust network infrastructure across Anduril's corporate and production environments, including new offices, data centers, and critical operational sites. Install, configure, and support a wide variety of multi-vendor network devices, including routers, switches, firewalls, and proxy servers, ensuring highly available and compliant network operations. Network Security & Optimization: Implement, manage, and optimize existing network solutions for corporate environments, focusing on security, performance, and reliability, including advanced routing protocols like BGP and modern datacenter architectures such as spine-leaf. Implement and maintain multi-site IPSec connectivity solutions for secure connections between remote sites and public cloud environments. Routinely audit, enforce, and maintain security policies and protocols for all network devices, including routers, switches, and firewalls, to meet security best practices and internal compliance requirements. Network Operations & Performance: Maximize network performance through ongoing monitoring, proactive troubleshooting, and root cause analysis. Investigate and resolve complex network faults, triage service requests from users, and respond to incident alerts, escalating to engineering teams when necessary. Ensure deployed network infrastructure adheres to configuration standards and maintain up-to-date firmware releases for all network equipment. Monitoring & Incident Management (Network Focus): Operate and continuously refine network monitoring and alerting solutions, ensuring comprehensive visibility into overall network health. Contribute to the implementation of network incident management pipelines, participate in post-mortems for network outages, and assist in generating network incident metric data. Manage on-call solutions (e.g., PagerDuty) specifically for network-related issues. Network Tooling & Automation: Utilize and support the development of automation scripts and tools (e.g., Python, Bash, Ansible, Terraform) to streamline network operations, enforce configurations, and reduce manual effort. Contribute to building integrations between operational tools and evaluate platforms for monitoring, inventory, and ticketing, ensuring alignment with broader Infrastructure automation strategies. Documentation & Inventory: Maintain and update comprehensive documentation of the network topology, infrastructure services, cabling diagrams, IP address allocations, IP routing/switching configurations, and all network infrastructure inventory. Create and update network-specific Technical Support Guides (TSGs) and runbooks. Procurement & Collaboration: Procure network equipment, manage subcontractors involved with network installations, and collaborate with engineering and telecom/LV teams to scope and plan network hardware needs. On-Call Support & Travel: Provide regular on-call support for network issues within a rotating schedule. Travel to remote site locations to evaluate requirements and perform network hardware installs and upgrades. Required Qualifications Minimum of 4+ years of hands-on experience as a Network Administrator, Network Engineer, or equivalent role in a production environment. Solid experience with vendor-agnostic network switching, routing, and wireless technologies. Hands-on experience with network security technologies, including configuring and managing stateful firewalls (specifically Palo Alto Networks, and Panorama), ACLs, and basic traffic monitoring (Taps/SPAN). Proficient technical knowledge of routing protocols (e.g., OSPF, BGP), Layer 2/3 switching, VLANs, VRFs, DNS, and QoS, with familiarity with modern datacenter designs like spine-leaf. Experience using network monitoring and packet analysis tools (e.g., Wireshark, SNMP, NetFlow) to maintain network health and troubleshoot issues. Familiarity with network automation tools and basic scripting (e.g., Python or Bash) to assist with routine configuration and management tasks. Familiarity with host-based networking configurations across Windows, MacOS, and Linux operating systems. Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve common network issues. Experience utilizing enterprise ticketing systems to manage and prioritize a personal ticket queue. Good documentation skills and clear verbal and written communication skills for collaborating with technical team members and end-users. Ability to travel for remote deployments when required, and participate in a weekly on-call rotation. Ability to obtain and maintain a US Secret Clearance Preferred Qualifications Experience with cloud networking (AWS, Azure, GCP) in secure or isolated environments. Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CCNA, CCNP, Palo Alto PCNSE, JNCIS, JNCIP). Experience with a variety of network vendors (e.g., Cisco, Aruba, Arista, Juniper, PaloAlto). Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) for network configuration management. Experience in a Zero Trust or BeyondCorp environment. Competence with testing tools and procedures for voice and data circuits. Experience with high-density wireless deployments and advanced RF optimization techniques (e.g., predictive modeling, site surveys, spectrum analysis). Familiarity with enterprise-grade wireless security solutions including 802.1X authentication, Guest portals, and Network Access Control (NAC) integration for both wired and wireless devices.
